label: Vue/Nuxt UI Kit Contract
description: Canonical frontend UI kit contract for retrieval, design review and future context-pack generation in the vue-nuxt profile.

primitive_families.name: action
primitive_families.purpose: Interactive controls that trigger primary or secondary user actions.

primitive_families.name: form
primitive_families.purpose: Inputs and controls used in capture and validation flows.

primitive_families.name: feedback
primitive_families.purpose: Status, helper and transient feedback primitives.

primitive_families.name: layout
primitive_families.purpose: Containers and visual shells that compose sections and pages.

primitive_families.name: navigation
primitive_families.purpose: Primitives for route switching, filtering and orientation.

primitive_families.name: data-display
primitive_families.purpose: Primitives for tables, lists, metrics and rich data presentation.

usage_rules.name: reuse-first-primitives
usage_rules.rule: If a screen can be composed from an existing primitive family, prefer reuse over introducing a new base component.
usage_rules.reason: Retrieval and design review should bias toward system consistency before local invention.

usage_rules.name: feature-wrapper-over-base-fork
usage_rules.rule: If the UI differs only in composition, create a feature wrapper instead of forking the base primitive.
usage_rules.reason: This keeps the base UI kit stable while allowing product-specific flows.

usage_rules.name: token-before-hardcode
usage_rules.rule: Colors, spacing, typography, radius and elevation should come from token sources before any local hardcoded value is introduced.
usage_rules.reason: Design-aware retrieval depends on stable token categories and consistent visual language.

usage_rules.name: gap-before-new-primitive
usage_rules.rule: If no canonical primitive matches the need, record a component gap before recommending a new base primitive.
usage_rules.reason: This makes design-system expansion explicit and explainable.
